relationships.subject: Tetrodotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: As previously described TTX, STX, and conotoxins play an important role as blockers of VGSC.

relationships.subject: Ciguatoxins
relationships.evidence_quote: These toxins are therefore activators of NaV channels.

relationships.subject: Saxitoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: pharmacologic blockage of NaV1.7 by a small-sized molecule agent with affinity for the channel’s resting state is sufficient for the production of an analgesic effect in a variety of preclinical pain models

key_findings: Review of marine toxins (TTX, STX, CTX, BTX, ATX) acting on VGSCs and their analgesic potential.
TTX blocks TTX-sensitive channels including NaV1.7; NaV1.8 and NaV1.9 are TTX-resistant.
